meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理数据时会用 uv 运行 Python,在 DuckDB 和 Polars 间自动选最优工具,总是带 numpy 和 pyarrow,绝不用 pandas,直接查询文件,完成后报告耗时和行数并解释选型。
howto.when: 当你提到“analyze the data”“summarize this”等关键词,或要求对 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件做筛选、排序、连接等数据操作时。纯文本/配置文件不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按类别汇总金额
say.note: 会自动选 DuckDB 直接查文件并返回汇总

say.text: 比较昨天和今天的数据,画个趋势图
say.note: 会包含 matplotlib 并做时间序列分析

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude processes data by running Python via uv, automatically selecting between DuckDB and Polars, always including numpy and pyarrow, never using pandas, querying files directly, and reporting time/row counts with tool-choice rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention trigger phrases like "analyze the data" or "summarize this", or request filtering, sorting, joining on CSV/Parquet/JSON files. Not for plain text or configs.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum amounts by category.
say_en.note: It picks DuckDB, queries the file directly, and returns the summary.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday vs today and plot a trend.
say_en.note: It includes matplotlib and runs time-series analysis.
